speed-organization-efficiency: Bigger page cache rejected: separate precache and MAX_PAGE_ENTRIES=60 already exist; missing lookup caused the reproduced failure.

token-cost: Model routing for network diagnosis rejected: affected path has zero inference calls (error-pages.js).
New offline asset bundler unselected: existing cached shell and native asset pipeline already own delivery; no measured bundle-size problem was demonstrated.
observability-honesty: Adapter-only restored label repaired under the selected UX outcome: actual request success is now required.
Separate public outage dashboard rejected: existing api/uptime.json and status surfaces own aggregate availability; no new consumer justified duplication.
sil-debt: Reference-format expansion unselected: existing reference gate passes current href/src tree; no new demonstrated broken journey in that survey.

items.title: Confirm origin reachability before reopening the offline page
items.why: Offline fallback reloads repeatedly while the adapter is online and the origin is unavailable.
items.userOutcome: Offline fallback reloads repeatedly while the adapter is online and the origin is unavailable.
items.recipe: Probe the original URL with a bounded no-store HEAD request; announce recovery and reload only after a successful response. Deduplicate probes and cancel on offline events.
items.acceptance: Failure, timeout, HTTP failure and redirected recovery must not reload; success reloads once; offline cancellation prevents delayed reload. Manual retry remains available.
items.stageRationale: Repair reproduced failures on the supported live release.

items.title: Use the existing public precache for failed offline navigation
items.why: The service worker ignores explicitly precached public pages when navigation fails.
items.userOutcome: The service worker ignores explicitly precached public pages when navigation fails.
items.recipe: After fresh PAGE_CACHE lookup, check only the current shell cache for the exact explicitly precached public navigation path, then return the current offline fallback. Preserve page TTL and request bypass rules.
items.acceptance: Fresh installed public /games/ opens offline; query variants use the public pathname; uncached/protected routes stay isolated; expired runtime pages are evicted; fresh runtime pages and successful network responses still win.
items.stageRationale: Repair reproduced failures on the supported live release.
